notes.title: Added Japanese language support
notes.content:
Update content: 

 Added Japanese language support, thanks for nicolith's help and support!

Thank you for every kindness!

notes.title: Recollection room now is available
notes.content:
This update includes: 

 Added a recollection room. (Located in the parent's room, unlocked automatically after clearing the game. Note: To enter it you need to walk through the door rather than press the interaction key.) 
 You can hide the text in dialogue with the "H" key. (For controller, use the Y button or the triangle button) 
 Some bug fixes.

notes.title: Tide Girl: Phenomena Small Update
notes.content:
Slightly increased the character's Y-axis movement speed.
Slightly adjusted the shape of some collisions.

Thank you for your support and advice!
